content.value: A jet of water A, whose velocity is $V _ { A } = 6 0$ fps, strikes a blade B which is (13) moving at $v _ { 8 } = 3 0$ fps in the same direction as A, shown in figure below. Eight pounds per second of water strike the blade, two-third passing without friction along the lower part, the rest across the upper. Determine the horizontal and vertical components of the force on the blade.
